guarantees.claim: data_in[i] and data_in_qe[i] are continuously driven from reg2hw.data_in[i].q and reg2hw.data_in[i].qe respectively, for all i in 0..NumRegsData-1.

uncertain_points.claim: The register qualifier error signal data_in_qe is forwarded without any local check; if downstream AES logic does not properly gate data_in when data_in_qe indicates an error, corrupted input data could be used, compromising ciphertext or plaintext confidentiality/integrity.
uncertain_points.cond: when a register parity/ECC error is present (qe asserted)
uncertain_points.risk: AES computation proceeds with corrupted data, leading to incorrect cryptographic results or side-channel leakage of secret material.
